title: Talk it through 4.1
role: Sustainability adviser explaining what would happen under different choices
can_do: I can use conditionals and the passive to talk about sustainable tourism.
I can explain what would have happened if a different choice had been made.

nodes.partner_line: What would happen if the park allowed unlimited visitors?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué pasaría si el parque permitiera visitantes ilimitados?

options.text: The wildlife would suffer, and the trails would be damaged.
It would bring money in, but at a very high cost to nature.
In the long term, the park would lose what made it special.

nodes.partner_line: And what would have happened without the daily limits?
nodes.translation: ¿Y qué habría pasado sin los límites diarios?
nodes.model_reply: The trails would have been badly damaged.

nodes.partner_line: What has been done to protect the wetland?
nodes.translation: ¿Qué se ha hecho para proteger el humedal?

options.text: Boardwalks have been built so that visitors do not trample the plants.
Access has been limited to guided groups only.
Fishing has been banned during the nesting season.

nodes.partner_line: If you could change one thing, what would it be?
nodes.translation: Si pudiera cambiar una cosa, ¿cuál sería?

options.text: I would introduce stricter rules for boats.
I would invest more in local education.
I would make the monitoring data public.

nodes.partner_line: If the community had not been consulted, would the plan have worked?
nodes.translation: Si no se hubiera consultado a la comunidad, ¿habría funcionado el plan?

options.text: No. Without local support, it would have failed.
Probably not; residents would have ignored the rules.
It might have worked, but it would not have lasted.

nodes.partner_line: A clear lesson. Thank you for sharing it.
nodes.translation: Una lección clara. Gracias por compartirla.

options.text: My pleasure. Good planning today protects tomorrow.
You are welcome. I hope others will follow.
Thank you. It is a lesson we learned the hard way.
